title: Antinociceptive Effects of Cannabichromene (CBC) in Mice: Insights from von Frey, Tail-Flick, Formalin, and Acetone Tests.
summary: New mouse antinociception assays support CBC effects; predicted receptor mechanisms remain unproven and human efficacy is not established.

evidence.tested: New mouse antinociception assays support CBC effects; predicted receptor mechanisms remain unproven and human efficacy is not established.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: DRIFT learned compound-target predictor is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
